commands.doc: A module of a palette card (the card and addDraft, r1.html:69334): on the given wall at the given place, or at the first free place along the wall (placesAlong); a mezzanine over the first tall cabinet without one (Д). The new module is selected.
«Отметить участок стены» (addDraft, r1.html:69335): the mark gets the next number of the kitchen, as in the prototype.
«Добавить полку» (k32Command 'add', r1.html:71611): the next free level of the grid above the last shelf (MOD-DEC-193, 196).
«Готово · свернуть помещение» (finish-room, r1.html:69459).
A card dropped on the plan (palettePointerUp, r1.html:69112): the module of the preview, or the refusal.
A module dropped where it was dragged (pointerUp, r1.html:69227); the old place is kept on a refusal.
Removes a module with the mezzanines over it (delete-item, r1.html:69492); refused when the worktops would not close.
The «×» of a mark (remove-obstacle, r1.html:69450).
«Удалить» of a shelf (kRemoveShelf, r1.html:70440).
«Ширина новых модулей» (default-width, r1.html:69529): the next ordinary modules; the existing ones stay.

The material of the facades of the whole kitchen (MOD-DEC-573): `materialId` null — the fronts of the prototype, of a board of the decor; a material of the catalogue of the release with its execution (the first one, or the one kept when the material stays) and the colour code or the species of venee
«Включить технику в итог» (kcd-appliances, r1.html:81807).
«Остров» (island-toggle, r1.html:69513): off only without island and peninsula modules.
«Материал корпусов» / «Материал фасадов» of the whole kitchen (kflow-corpus, kflow-facade, r1.html:70466).

A control of the panels «Наполнение» and «Фасады» (KitchenModuleField.key). A number must be finite (the kcr layer's words for every field, Д: the prototype passed NaN of an empty field to its check, FINDINGS 664).

The decor of the selected module (kflow-local-corpus, kflow-local-facade, r1.html:70485): '' or null — «Наследовать общий», the module's own value removed; the module is checked by the one check of K3/K4 as every edit of a module.

Sets one setting of the whole kitchen: every module it concerns takes the value, a new module takes it too. The worktop — every floor cabinet under a worktop; the supports — every module on the supports 9028286, a tall cabinet keeps its top at the wall cabinets (MOD-DEC-567), a niche of a machine on
The side of the corner of an L kitchen (room-orientation, r1.html:69565).
A size of the room (setRoom, r1.html:69396): the room is confirmed by it; refused when a module no longer fits.
«Полка N · фиксированная» (k7Fixed, r1.html:71498).

The level of a shelf from the bottom of the cavity (the change of data-k-shelf, r1.html:71671; k32Move 'exact', 71561): whole millimetres with System 32 off (MOD-DEC-196), the check of the module after the move.
The type of the kitchen (setType, r1.html:69416): confirmed by the choice; a U kitchen is «left».
A change of a module (tryUpdate, r1.html:69361): the module is checked in the kitchen as it would be.
A new drawer in the section (W7): internal by default; an external one behind a door is refused (WR-30).
«Добавить ящик сверху» over the top drawer (FINDINGS 1139).

«Добавить перегородку» inside the section `index` (fiSplit r1.html:92594 — a partition drawn from the bottom to the roof; MOD-DEC-550 п. 2, 570): a full-height partition stands `leftMm` from the left of the clear opening and cuts the section into two of one body; each section keeps 160 mm (565). The

A new clothes rod in the section (MOD-DEC-290, 310, 333): its top by the section of the rod of the project from the catalogue (FIT, 480), not the prototype's 20 mm. The rod is a mechanism of the graph: no part.
A new fixed shelf in the section by the owner's rules (MOD-DEC-193, 225).

A new basket for linen or for shoes, trouser rack or pantograph in the section (MOD-DEC-484): the item of the catalogue for its width and depth, in the free height of the section; behind a door — as an inner drawer (288, 331, 360, 050).

«Добавить стоевую» of the prototype (r1.html:90728, MOD-DEC-199: a partial upright stands on the bottom): in the middle of the section, the full inner height. The part needs the confirmation of the technology, as in r1.
The type of a shelf: fixed or removable on supports (MOD-DEC-312).
«Распределить полки» (U2): equal clear openings in each span of the section on the grid of System 32.
«Дублировать» a shelf, a rod or the top drawer (FINDINGS 1139).
«Равная высота» (r1.html:83563): the rows share the field equally again.
«Удалить разделение» (r1.html:83580): the row joins its neighbour above (the top row — the one below) with the seam between them. The last row left is the door of the section again.
Moves a drawer to the height of its bottom over the interior bottom, the shelf over it with it (FINDINGS 1073; FE-04, MOD-DEC-175).

The seam over the row `seam` moved to `yMm` from the floor (MOD-DEC-560): the row below takes the new height, the row above the rest, the other rows keep theirs; a fixed shelf nearer than 20 mm draws the seam to its middle. Each of the two rows stays at least 80 mm.

The place of the partition on the left of the section `index`: the clear opening on its left, mm (the field «Слева» of the filling layer, fiDividerMove r1.html:92927 → ckSectionWidth): the section on the left takes the change, the one on the right gives it, as a width of a section does (MOD-DEC-199)
Moves a rod to the height of its axis over the interior bottom (FINDINGS 1073; MOD-DEC-310, 333).
Moves a shelf to the height of its middle over the interior bottom (U2; MOD-DEC-193, 196, 312).
Removes a drawer of the section; without drawers the door gets ordinary hinges again (MOD-DEC-311).

«Удалить перегородку» (ckMergePartition r1.html:90251; MOD-DEC-550 п. 4, 570): the partition on the left of the section `index` goes and the two sections of one body become one of their width. The fill of both stays at its heights (shelves with their types, loads, depths, ids; rods; the drawers of t

Removes one section (MOD-DEC-199): the other sections of its body share the body equally again (widths set by hand in this body are reset), the other bodies keep theirs. A body left without sections goes; its width goes to the neighbour on the right, of the last body to the left ((Д), as a body widt
Removes a shelf of the section (U2): the other shelves keep their heights, types and ids.
Removes a basket, a trouser rack or a pantograph of the section (MOD-DEC-484).
Removes an upright (r1.html:90753).
Base of all bodies: plinth, fixed legs, legs behind a decorative plinth or none (MOD-DEC-291, 171, 483), with its height; «Ножки» by the range of baseHeightLimits when `hw` is given.

Width of one body on the floor (ckBodyWidth r1.html:90179, MOD-DEC-199): the neighbour on the right takes the difference, the last body — the one on its left; the overall width does not change. The sections of both bodies change in proportion, the layout becomes manual (MOD-DEC-322, п. 4), the mezza
Carcass decor, as the prototype writes it (decorChoices, mfSelectDecor r1.html:58320).
The height of the box of a drawer, 80–320 mm (FINDINGS 1138).
Internal or external drawer (FINDINGS 1138; WR-30 behind a door).
The gap over a drawer; the drawers over it move by the change (FINDINGS 1138).
The drawers of the project (MOD-DEC-544): a series, 'TIER', or null — the own box. An unknown series is refused.
The decor of the bands of the visible edges (MOD-DEC-483): of the part (the default) or of the facades.
Facade of a section: no door, one door, two doors (MOD-DEC-286: two doors meet on half-overlay hinges) or a lift front (MOD-DEC-320).

The material of the facades (MOD-DEC-573): `materialId` null — the doors are made from the corpus board (347); a material of the catalogue of the release with its execution (the first one, or the one kept when the material stays) and its colour: a decor of its board (it goes to the cutting plan), a

The material of the doors (MOD-DEC-347): null — made in the order from the corpus board, in its decor; a decor of the catalogue — a ready-made door of that decor, out of the cutting plan, its cups drilled by the supplier (FINDINGS 266), priced by the chosen tariff or «Цена не определена» without one

Mounting of the doors of every section (MOD-DEC-221: one choice «Тип фасадов» for the wardrobe): накладные in front of the carcass or вкладные in the opening with the gap of MOD-DEC-362. The facade field changes, so rows of heights set by hand are shared equally again ((Д), FINDINGS 404): the height

Doors of a row (one or two, r1.html:83557; none — an open opening of the section, MOD-DEC-561) and the hinge side of one door. One row of the section keeps a door: a section without any is «Без двери» of the section.
The height of a row (r1.html:83600): the top row takes the difference, the top row itself — the bottom one; each row stays at least 80 mm.
Sets the rod series, the handle ('NONE' — без ручек) or the leg of the project; null puts the default back. An id the catalogue does not have is refused, the project is not changed.
Hinge side of a single door.

«Ножки» (MOD-DEC-481): the bodies go on legs at a height an open leg of the catalogue gives — the current one when a leg gives it, else the nearest (from the plinth of 70 mm — 50 mm); the legs under a plinth are for «Ножки за цоколем» (483). A load-bearing plinth of board has no legs at any height (
Kind of the lift front of a section and the mass of its handle (task LIFT; null — not entered, INV-D18-01 says so).
Lighting of the project (MOD-DEC-483): the whole wardrobe on or off, or one section (`sectionId`) on or off. Turning a section off while the whole wardrobe is lit lights the others by name.

The mezzanine of the wardrobe (MOD-DEC-200): a separate upper body over every body, of `height` (default 400 mm) in the overall height, with one section; null removes it with its sections. A new height keeps the sections.
Roof or back panel of all bodies on or off (prototype: «Крыша», «Задняя стенка»; without the back — 168, 309).

«Ножки за цоколем» (MOD-DEC-483): the bodies go on the legs under a plinth at a height such a leg gives — the current one when it does, else the nearest (from the plinth of 70 mm — 80 mm on the leg H.80); the decorative plinth of board stands in front of them on clips.

«Тип изделия» (swProduct, r1.html:61580): the sliding wardrobe keeps the carcass and the fill. The first switch of a project (no doors configured yet) is the prototype's fresh one (r1.html:84700): no doors, the base «Нет», the swing fronts off, the depth read as the depth of the sides (the depth of

Doors opened by pressing (MOD-DEC-485): on — the doors get the hinges without a spring (BOYARD ЭVO H901) and a latch each, and lose their handles; the drawers and the lift fronts keep their handles. Off removes the choice.
The depth of the axis of a rod from the front edge (FINDINGS 1137; r1 `depthAxis`).

The room (the fields of «Помещение и установка», r1.html:90598): niche, walls, the width of the place, the ceiling, the assembly, the skirting with its height and projection. A size is a positive whole number of mm or null (not given); the graph checks the lift, the height and the width (roomInstall
Number of sections: the kept ones stay as they are, new ones are empty with the facade of the last one.

Width of one section (ckSectionWidth r1.html:90299, MOD-DEC-199): the neighbour on the right in the same body takes the difference, the last section of a body — the one on its left; the body and the overall width do not change. A section that fills its body is refused: its width is the width of the
The front setback or the depth of a shelf, its rear kept (FINDINGS 1136; r1 fiEditOne).

The decor of the left or the right outer side of the wardrobe (MOD-DEC-483): «в цвет корпуса» (the default), «в цвет фасадов» or a decor of the catalogue; the inner partitions stay the carcass's. The sheets of that decor are cut and priced apart.
Overall size: width and height are the prototype's controls, the depth is the depth model (FINDINGS 8).

The doors of the sliding wardrobe, as the prototype commits them (swCommit with its layers, r1.html:63387, 84699, 85695): the configuration of the project with the patch over it and stable ids of the leaves; a scheme of four leaves falls back to «Чередование» when the number changes, «Три дорожки» o

The insert of the leaves (MOD-DEC-573, 140; FINDINGS 1615–1617): «материал → исполнение → цвет» of the catalogue. 'CARCASS' — in the decor of the carcass (the choice of the material of the facades goes); the control material of the prototype; a material of the facades made from a board (ЛДСП, ЛМДФ)

The insert of one leaf (MOD-DEC-573, 140; FINDINGS 1618–1620): 'DOORS' — as the doors; a material of the catalogue of the facades made from a board (ЛДСП, ЛМДФ) with a decor of it (the one asked, the one the leaf had, the decor of the doors, else the first). The record is the prototype's `leafMateri

The colour of the baskets, trouser racks and pantographs of the project (MOD-DEC-484): white, graphite or black; null puts the default (white) back. A pantograph has no white: it is grey metallic then.
Height and place of an upright from the left of its section (the fields «Высота перегородки», «От левого края» of r1.html:90751).

«Разделить по высоте» (r1.html:83565): the row (the top one when none is given) is cut into two of equal height with the seam between them; up to the rows of the policy (4). A row lower than 2 × 80 mm with the seam is refused.
